description: The true path of the miniature: a watchman's card punched every hour but three; the gap pointed out as the reader's own entry, set against his statement that he made every round; the gate fast at half past two and on the latch at half past three; the carter in splints.

moves.why: Every hour from twelve until five, and the card has twelve, one, two, four and five: nothing at three.
He says he made every round; the card has none at three.

moves.see: at half past two the yard gate was fast

moves.why: On the latch at half past three: opened in the hour between.
Not after five: the gate was open by half past three.

moves.pick: between half past two and half past three
moves.why: Between half past two and half past three.
Whoever took it opened the gate in that hour.

moves.see: Ward was not at the station in that hour
moves.why: And the one round Ward missed is the round at three, in that hour.

moves.see: could not have stood under a bale
moves.why: Tanner has the other key, but he is in splints.
Ward, away from his round in the hour the gate was opened.
